spans.s:
n. (-लं)
1 Oil, expressed oil, prepared from sesamum, mustard, &c.
3 Storax, gum benzoin, incense.
E.
तिल sesamum, and अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
A small quantity of oil.
E.
तैल, and कन् diminutive affix.

m. (-रः)
An oil manufacturer.
E.
तैल, and कार who makes.

m. (-ट्टं)
The oil cake, a cake made of the oily seed, after expression.
E.
तैल, and किट्ट sediment.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The part of the peninsula south of Orissa to Madras, the modern Carnatic.

f. (-का)
A cockroach.
E.
तैल oil, चुर to steal, ण्वुल् affix; it is also sometimes read तैलाचारिका from चर to go, with आङ् prefixed, and ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-णी)
A bathing tub for an oil bath.
E.
तैल, and द्रोणी a bucket.

m. (-कः)
A cockroach.
E.
तैल, and पच to digest, अच् aff.

n. (-कं)
White Sandal wood.
E.
तिलपर्णी Sandal wood, affix कन्.

Sandal.
2

Incense.
3

Turpentine.
E.
तिल sesamum, and पर्ण a leaf, affix अण् and ङीप्.

f. (-पा)
A cockroach.
E.
तैल oil, and पा who drinks.

f. (-का)
A cockroach.
E.
तैल oil, पा to drink, ण्वुल् affix, and यक् inserted.

f. (-का)
The small red ant.
E.
तैल, and पिपीलिका an ant.

f. (-ली)
A wick, the cotton of a lamp.
E.
तैल oil, माला a necklace, ङीप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Blending with oil, &c.
f. (-ता)
Oblation to fire.
E.
तिल sesamum, पत to go or alight, घञ् affix, and नुम् augment.

n. (-नं)
A fragrant substance, (Civet.)
E.
तैल oil, and साधन menstruum.

m. (-कः)
A sort of gem, (Amber.)
E.
तैल oil, and स्फटिक crystal.

f. (-टी)
A wasp.
E.
तैल oil, and अट to go, affixes अण् and ङीप्.

f. (-का)
A cockroach.
E.
तैल oil, अम्बु water or drink, कन् aff.

m. (-कः)
An oilman.
E.
तैल, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Relating or belonging to oil, oily, &c.
m. (-ली)
An oilman, an oil grinder or preparer.
f. (-लिनी)
1 The wick or cotton of a lamp.
2 A kind of insect found in oil.
E.
तैल oil, affix इनि.

f. (-ला)
An oil mill.
E.
तैलिन् an oilman, and शाला a house or hall.

n. (-नं)
A field of sesamum.
E.
तिल sesamum, and खञ् aff.
